vat.name: Goods and Services Tax
vat.statute: Goods and Services Tax Act 2009 s. 14 (3) (b) (15 %), Second Schedule items 4-10 (exempt supplies), NRA compilation to 2016; s. 14 not amended by the Finance Acts 2017-2025
vat.doc: s. 14 (3): "The rate of GST applicable to a taxable supply or import is (a) if the supply or import is zero-rated under the First Schedule, zero per cent; (b) in any other case, 15 per cent." Second Schedule: "4. Supply: Water. 5. Supply: Printed matter (books and newspapers). 6. Supply: Education services 7. Supply: Medical services and pharmaceuticals. 8. Supply: Transportation of passengers 9. Supply: Crude oil and hydrocarbon products. 10. Supply: Financial services." The Finance Acts 2017-2025 amend ss. 2, 6, 8, 15, 19, 31, 34, 37, 58, 90, 99 and the Second Schedule (additions such as teaching materials and local vegetable oil), not s. 14.
notes: Second Schedule descriptions limit some items (e.g. passenger transport, hydrocarbon products); the basket lines are taken as exempt in full
land and buildings (item 12) not separable from rent; later Second Schedule additions (FA 2021-2024) not applied
